about.title: Neighbourhood dentistry, done properly
body: Diya's Dental Care was started with a simple goal — give Kattupakkam and the wider Chennai west-side a dental clinic that's genuinely comfortable to visit, not just a place you go when something hurts. Every treatment room is built around patient comfort, from clear explanations before any procedure to sterilized instruments for every single patient.

Our dentists handle everything from a routine scaling and cleaning to root canals, extractions, braces, and cosmetic work like whitening — so most families don't need to be referred elsewhere. We keep evening hours specifically so working patients and students don't have to take time off to see us.
highlights: Evening slots until 8:30 PM, Monday to Saturday
Modern, sterilized equipment for every patient
General, cosmetic, and pediatric dentistry under one roof
Clear, upfront explanation before any treatment begins

services.name: Root Canal Treatment
services.tagline: Save the tooth, stop the pain
services.overview: Modern, largely painless root canal treatment to remove infection and save teeth that would otherwise need extraction, using local anesthesia and rotary instruments for a faster procedure.
symptoms: Persistent tooth pain, especially with hot or cold
Swelling or tenderness in the gums
procedure: Diagnosis and X-ray to confirm infection
Removal of infected pulp and cleaning of canals
benefits: Saves the natural tooth instead of extraction
Completed in 1–2 visits for most cases
services.recovery: Mild sensitivity for a day or two is normal; most patients return to normal eating within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Is root canal treatment painful?
faqs.answer: With modern local anesthesia, the procedure itself is largely painless — most patients feel far less discomfort than they expect.

faqs.question: How many visits does it take?
faqs.answer: Most root canals are completed in 1–2 visits, depending on the tooth and extent of infection.

services.name: Teeth Whitening & Cosmetic Dentistry
services.overview: In-clinic teeth whitening and cosmetic treatments including veneers and smile makeovers, tailored to your natural tooth shape and shade.
benefits: Visible results in a single sitting
Custom options for veneers and smile design
services.recovery: No downtime — most patients resume normal activity immediately.

faqs.question: How long do whitening results last?
faqs.answer: With good oral care and avoiding heavy staining foods, results typically last 6–12 months before a touch-up is needed.

services.name: Braces & Orthodontics
services.tagline: Straighter teeth for teens and adults
services.overview: Traditional braces and orthodontic treatment to correct crowding, gaps, and bite issues, managed by Dr. Divya from initial assessment through to retention.
benefits: Corrects both alignment and bite issues

faqs.question: How long does braces treatment take?
faqs.answer: Most cases take 12–24 months depending on the extent of correction needed.

services.name: Dental Implants
services.tagline: A permanent solution for missing teeth
services.overview: Dental implants to replace missing teeth with a fixed, natural-looking solution — a durable alternative to bridges and dentures.
benefits: Functions and looks like a natural tooth
services.recovery: Initial healing takes 1–2 weeks; full integration before crown placement typically takes 2–4 months.

services.name: Tooth Extraction & Oral Surgery
services.tagline: Safe, gentle removal when a tooth can't be saved
services.overview: Simple and surgical tooth extractions, including wisdom teeth, performed with local anesthesia and clear aftercare guidance.
procedure: Aftercare instructions and, if needed, follow-up review
benefits: Resolves pain from damaged or impacted teeth
Prevents further infection or crowding issues
services.recovery: Most patients recover within 2–3 days; wisdom tooth extractions may take up to a week.

faqs.question: Will I be in pain after extraction?
faqs.answer: Some soreness is normal for a day or two — we provide pain management guidance and medication as needed.

blogPosts.title: 5 Signs You Shouldn't Ignore Before Your Next Dental Checkup
blogPosts.excerpt: Most dental problems are painless in the early stages — here's what to watch for before it becomes an emergency.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Arjun Krishnan
content: Dental problems rarely start with pain — by the time something hurts, the underlying issue has usually been developing for weeks or months. Catching the early signs can be the difference between a simple filling and a root canal.

Bleeding gums during brushing or flossing is one of the most commonly ignored signs. It's often written off as brushing too hard, but persistent bleeding usually points to early gum disease that's easily treated if caught in time.

Sensitivity to hot or cold that lingers for more than a few seconds after the trigger is removed is different from ordinary sensitivity — it often signals decay reaching closer to the nerve, and is worth getting checked before it turns into a root canal situation.
Persistent bad breath despite regular brushing can point to bacteria buildup below the gumline or an underlying cavity, not just something you ate.

Finally, a clicking or popping jaw, or pain while chewing, can indicate bite issues or TMJ problems that are worth addressing early. If any of these sound familiar, it's worth booking a checkup rather than waiting for pain to force the issue.
